Package org.lwjgl.opengles

@NullMarked package org.lwjgl.opengles
Contains bindings to the OpenGL ES, a royalty-free, cross-platform API for full-function 2D and 3D graphics on embedded systems - including consoles, phones, appliances and vehicles. It consists of well-defined subsets of desktop OpenGL, creating a flexible and powerful low-level interface between software and graphics acceleration.
